## Change

Describe the concrete problem, resulting behavior and why these paths belong in
the public export.

## Validation

List the exact commit, commands and results. State missing/failed checks and any
limits; mock tests do not establish live/native behavior.

- [ ] Changes are limited to reviewed public paths; no private history or data.
- [ ] Inputs and attachments are synthetic; no credentials, owner settings or backups.
- [ ] Contribution rights, dependency licenses and notices have been checked.
- [ ] Defaults and documented unqualified behaviors remain honest.
- [ ] Version identifies these builds correctly; manifest covers the final files.
- [ ] Public source/sdist/wheel checks pass, or unresolved results are described.
- [ ] No release, settings change or live installation action is implied by this PR.
